newsitem.title: USA: US Democrat to highlight China trade differences.
newsitem.headline: US Democrat to highlight China trade differences.

text.p: House Democratic Leader Dick Gephardt is scheduled to give a major speech in Detroit next week in which he will sharpen his differences with President Clinton on trade with China, congressional sources said on Tuesday.
Clinton announced Monday he wants to renew China's most favored nation trading status. That is certain to provoke an emotional fight in Congress, which can vote against such a move.
Gephardt, a Missouri Democrat, in the past has opposed most favored nation trading status for China.
"He will lay out what he sees as major trade challenges" including progress on human rights issues, a Congressional aide said.
